default_jql: project = XXX AND type in (Story, Bug, Task) AND resolved is not EMPTY
analysis_description: Process Behavior Charts (PBCs) help identify trends and special causes in lead time metrics using statistical process control. Based on DORA metrics best practices.

control_chart_info.median: The middle value of all lead times - represents typical performance
control_chart_info.p85: 85th percentile - 85% of issues are completed within this timeframe
control_chart_info.ucl: Upper Control Limit - 3 standard deviations above mean (natural process limit)
control_chart_info.lcl: Lower Control Limit - 3 standard deviations below mean (natural process limit)

special_cause_rules: Seven or more consecutive points trending up or down
Eight or more consecutive points on same side of center line
